items.statement: No signal must be distinguished from unavailable probes, completed negative observations and incomplete evidence coverage.
items.feature: Evidence normalization, unknown findings, quality flags and coverage-aware readiness assessment
items.unknown_behavior: Never translate a failed or incomplete probe into a confirmed absent device or healthy result.
verification: Unavailable scans remain distinct from completed scans with no device.
Coverage is reported separately from readiness.
Contradictory evidence sets a quality flag and all denied operations stay denied.

items.statement: A suggested remediation is not an authorization to mutate a device or upload local information.
items.feature: Fail-closed operation authorization and explicit user-origin gates
items.unknown_behavior: Device mutation and network upload remain denied unless a separately reviewed policy is introduced.
verification: User-only export actions require user origin.
Device mutation and upload are denied by default.
